title: Relationships
tagline: Build relationships naturally and organically in a world where every character is unique
description:
Relationships allows you to establish and build relationships in a way that feels natural and organic in a SkyrimNet-driven world. Every character has a unique combination of traits and attributes that make them behave and react to you in their own way.

Some characters fall deeply in love but want to save themselves for marriage, while others shun commitment but are open to dating with no strings attached. Getting to know them and treating them accordingly is the whole point, just as in real life. Settings give you control over how quickly relationships progress. Relationships can also regress as warranted.

This applies to both romantic and platonic relationships. Deciding to progress to a romantic relationship requires mutual consent. A successful marriage proposal requires progressing to the highest tier.

Optionally integrates with its companion mod Kinship, so your significant other(s) and children are aware of their relationships to one another and act accordingly. Settings can ensure that your children are blocked from having romantic relations but can still grow their platonic bond.

Requires:
- SkyrimNet Beta 25+
- SKSE64
- Address Library for SKSE Plugins
- PapyrusUtil SE
- powerofthree's Papyrus Extender
- Papyrus MessageBox (Nexus 83578; required for the consent prompt; bundled by MARAS)

Optionally supports:
- Kinship ( for awareness of familial ties )
- M.A.R.A.S. ( for marriage )
- OStim Community Resource ( for attractiveness rating )
- SeverActions ( for custom bio blocks )
- Merdian UI (non-VR users only)
- Prisma UI

Contains no adult content.
author: deadohiosky
changelog:
**They remember where they stand with you, every time.** Sometimes a close friend or a spouse talked to you like a stranger for no reason. That's fixed. How they feel about you is there in every conversation now, even the first one after you load.

**Old friends aren't strangers.** If you've known someone for months, they won't be treated like someone you met yesterday. And for a history that started before Relationships was installed, open their card and write it under Your history with them: "Beirand and I have been friends since his apprenticeship in Hammerfell." They'll take it as fact, and they'll remember it when you talk.

**Two new Bond Pace settings.** Very Slow for a romance that takes the whole playthrough, Very Fast if you play at a low timescale and want things to move.

**What they call you sticks only when it was actually said.** No more pet names pulled from months-old memories, or garbled ones. Tell someone "call me Handsome" and it sticks, even in an otherwise quiet chat. If a name's wrong, Forget what they call you on their card clears it, and they'll stop using it.

**Re-author can start their bio blocks over**, including ones you picked, if you tick the new box.

Characters stay warm and affectionate while they're not ready for more, and nobody sparks a romance minutes after meeting you.

Install over 2.3.x with Replace, DLL included; saves carry over. Requires SkyrimNet Beta 25 or newer, SKSE and Address Library. For the dashboard: Meridian UI 1.5.0+, Magelight UI 0.30.5+ or Prisma UI 1.5.1+.
